__metadata.description: dk-data Transformations — SQLMesh model row counts, transformation duration, entity resolution, lineage DAG

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'mol_bronze' AND table_name NOT LIKE '%__%'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'mol_silver' AND table_name NOT LIKE '%__%'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'mol_gold' AND table_name NOT LIKE '%__%'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlmesh._snapshots
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ops.ingestion_jobs WHERE started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND status = 'failed'

SELECT table_name AS "Model", 'mol_bronze' AS "Schema", (xpath('/row/c/text()', query_to_xml(format('SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM mol_bronze.%I', table_name), false, true, '')))[1]::text::int AS "Rows" FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'mol_bronze' AND table_name NOT LIKE '%__%' ORDER BY table_name
SELECT SPLIT_PART(name, '.', 2) AS "Schema", COUNT(*) AS "Snapshots", COUNT(DISTINCT SPLIT_PART(name, '.', 3)) AS "Models" FROM sqlmesh._snapshots GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT 'molecules' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM mol_silver.molecules UNION ALL SELECT 'clinical_trials', COUNT(*) FROM mol_silver.clinical_trials UNION ALL SELECT 'adverse_events', COUNT(*) FROM mol_silver.adverse_events UNION ALL SELECT 'bioactivity', COUNT(*) FROM mol_silver.bioactivity UNION ALL SELECT 'drug_labels', COUNT(*) FROM mol_silver.drug_labels UNION ALL SELECT 'identifier_mappings', COUNT(*) FROM mol_silver.identifier_mappings UNION ALL SELECT 'targets', COUNT(*) FROM mol_silver.targets UNION ALL SELECT 'epo_patents', COUNT(*) FROM mol_silver.epo_patents UNION ALL SELECT 'financial_filings', COUNT(*) FROM mol_silver.financial_filings ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT 'molecule_profile' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM mol_gold.molecule_profile UNION ALL SELECT 'safety_signals', COUNT(*) FROM mol_gold.safety_signals UNION ALL SELECT 'lifecycle_stages', COUNT(*) FROM mol_gold.lifecycle_stages UNION ALL SELECT 'competitive_landscape', COUNT(*) FROM mol_gold.competitive_landscape UNION ALL SELECT 'regulatory_timeline', COUNT(*) FROM mol_gold.regulatory_timeline UNION ALL SELECT 'advocacy_groups', COUNT(*) FROM mol_gold.advocacy_groups UNION ALL SELECT 'company_pipeline', COUNT(*) FROM mol_gold.company_pipeline ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT source AS "Source", ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (completed_at - started_at)))::numeric, 1) AS "Avg Duration (s)", ROUND(MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (completed_at - started_at)))::numeric, 1) AS "Max Duration (s)", COUNT(*) AS "Runs", SUM(records_processed) AS "Total Records" FROM ops.ingestion_jobs WHERE started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY source ORDER BY "Avg Duration (s)" DESC

SELECT started_at AS time, source AS metric, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (completed_at - started_at)) AS value FROM ops.ingestion_jobs WHERE started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY started_at
SELECT started_at AS time, source AS metric, records_processed AS value FROM ops.ingestion_jobs WHERE started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND status = 'completed' ORDER BY started_at

SELECT name AS "Environment", plan_id AS "Plan ID", TO_TIMESTAMP(finalized_ts / 1000) AS "Finalized At", jsonb_array_length(snapshots::jsonb) AS "Snapshot Count" FROM sqlmesh._environments ORDER BY name

panels.title: mol — Molecule Core (chemistry · drugbank · binding)
panels.description: Molecule identity, chemistry properties, binding affinities, bioactivity data. Schemas: mol_raw → mol_bronze → mol_silver → mol_gold.

targets.rawSql:
WITH all_nodes AS (
  SELECT source_model AS model_name, source_layer AS layer FROM meta.model_lineage WHERE domain = 'mol' AND subdomain = 'mol-molecule-core'
  UNION
  SELECT target_model, target_layer FROM meta.model_lineage WHERE domain = 'mol' AND subdomain = 'mol-molecule-core'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  model_name AS id,
  SPLIT_PART(model_name, '.', 2) AS title,
  SPLIT_PART(model_name, '.', 1) AS subtitle,
  layer AS mainStat,
  CASE WHEN layer IN ('raw','external') THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS "arc__raw",
  CASE WHEN layer = 'bronze' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS "arc__bronze",
  CASE WHEN layer = 'silver' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS "arc__silver",
  CASE WHEN layer = 'gold' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS "arc__gold"
FROM all_nodes
ORDER BY layer, model_name

SELECT
  source_model || '__' || target_model AS id,
  source_model AS source,
  target_model AS target
FROM meta.model_lineage
WHERE domain = 'mol' AND subdomain = 'mol-molecule-core'
